issues.title: Cancel editing properties should reset updating value and not close the left panel
issues.body:
## 🐞 Bug description
Cancel editing properties should reset updating value and not close the left panel

## 🔢 Steps to Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Play game with data wargame-l6nngxlk
2. Click on channel 'Core Mapping'
3. Select a item
5. Update properties of the item
6. Click 'Cancel' button
7. Notice the left panel is closed and not reset updating value

View more details on below screencast
## ⚙️ Expected behavior
Cancel editing properties should only reset the updating value and not close the left panel

## 🖥️ Screencast

https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/758bdd37-9e91-485b-a7c9-490c9e14fbc9



## 💻 System information
 - Browser : Chrome
 - Browser Version : Version 120.0.6099.111
